requirements.quote: Repos declare a **pre-merge guard set** (`forge.yaml`, e.g. "all `test_*guard*.py`, contract tests"): fast static tests that apply to every change. Every lane runs them on the merged result before merging; failure blocks the merge.

When a lane hits a base failure, attribute it to the commit that introduced it (here `13834f1c51` from #39805) and file or reopen against that issue automatically, instead of escalating the unrelated lane to needs-human.
With a guard set configured, a lane whose change breaks a guard test cannot merge.
A base failure is attributed to its introducing merge/issue, and the blocked lane is deferred behind the fix, not sent to needs-human.

deliverables.change: New pure module: classify failed guard commands as lane-own vs base-red from a base run; attribute base red to the introducing commit and issue number via git log on the failing test path and (#N)/Closes #N parsing.
Unit tests for classify and attribute (lane-own, base-red, unattributable, issue parsing).

In the precheck failure branch, after the fix round, run still-failing guard/invariant commands on base via io.preflightRun: base-red -> comment/reopen introducing issue and end deferred with base.red; lane-own -> block (ci.red). Rerun invariants on the base-synced merged tree before merge if not already done.
Parse the guard blocking switch (verify.guard_block, default on when invariants is non-empty).
Add BASE_RED 'base.red' as a deferred (non-needs-human, non-breaker) outcome code.
Pass the guard_block key through readVerify; map base.red to a deferred requeue.
Lane tests: failing invariant blocks the merge; same failure on base defers with base.red, comments on the introducing issue and does not go needs-human.
Document guard_block, invariants as the pre-merge guard set, and base.red.
Document basered.mjs and the base.red flow.

preserve.what: verify.invariants semantics: never scoped away by the test map, deduped, budgeted (bin/lean/precheck.mjs:133-141)
verify.precheck_block opt-in behaviour for non-invariant declared checks (bin/lean/lean.mjs:1933)
A repo with no invariants configured behaves exactly as before

decisions.choice: Reuse verify.invariants as the guard set instead of adding a parallel key
decisions.justification: It already runs unscoped in every verify mode (bin/lean/precheck.mjs:129-141, docs/CONFIG.md:1005); the gap is blocking and base attribution, not declaration

decisions.choice: Deterministic attribution via git log + (#N) parsing, no LLM
decisions.justification: NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 1 (deterministic first); commit subjects carry (#N) in this repo's history

decisions.choice: Run the base comparison through the existing io.preflightRun seam
decisions.justification: bin/lean/lean.mjs:1524-1560 already runs commands on a base worktree
